# **0. 資料及functions匯入**
```{r}

Cdat1_yn<-readRDS("./分析用資料/Cdat1_yn")
Cdat2_yn<-readRDS("./分析用資料/Cdat2_yn")

Cdat1_yn.ju<-readRDS("./分析用資料/Cdat1_yn.ju")
Cdat2_yn.ju<-readRDS("./分析用資料/Cdat2_yn.ju")

Cdat1_yn.se<-readRDS("./分析用資料/Cdat1_yn.se")
Cdat2_yn.se<-readRDS("./分析用資料/Cdat2_yn.se")

Cdat1_yn.st<-readRDS("./分析用資料/Cdat1_yn.st")
Cdat2_yn.st<-readRDS("./分析用資料/Cdat2_yn.st")

# 匯入答案
ans<-read_xlsx(".\\data_record_和平桃農.xlsx")[1,-c(1:4,35:44,55:67)]

ans1<-ans[1:30]

ans0<-str_replace_all(names(ans),"是非","")

Cdat1_yn.st.mat<-sapply(names(ans), function(i) (Cdat1_yn.st[,i]%>%factor(levels=c("正確","錯誤"),labels=c(1,0))%>%as.numeric())-1)

Cdat2_yn.st.mat<-sapply(names(ans), function(i) (Cdat2_yn.st[,i]%>%factor(levels=c("正確","錯誤"),labels=c(1,0))%>%as.numeric())-1)

Cdat_yn.st.mat<-rbind(Cdat1_yn.st.mat, Cdat2_yn.st.mat)


## 匯入早餐學習單資料
eat<-read_xlsx(".\\早餐學習單_兩批彙整.xlsx",skip=1)%>%as.data.frame()

typee<-readRDS("./分析用資料/typee")
typee$sense2<-0
typee$sense2[c(6,7,9,12,15,18:20,23,26:28)]<-1

## 匯入functions
source("./functions_是非題.R")

```

# **1. 高低分組得分分析**

## **1-1 前/後測生是非得分、總得分的敘述統計**
```{r}
out<-matrix(NA,5,4)
rownames(out)<-c("最大值","第3四分位數(上界)","中位數","第1四分位數(下界)","最小值")
colnames(out)<-rep(c("前測","後測"),2)
out[,1]<-fivenum(Cdat1_yn$生是非得分)%>%rev()
out[,2]<-fivenum(Cdat2_yn$生是非得分)%>%rev()
out[,3]<-fivenum(Cdat1_yn$總得分)%>%rev()
out[,4]<-fivenum(Cdat2_yn$總得分)%>%rev()

out%>%kable("html",escape = F,booktabs = TRUE, caption="1-1 前/後測生是非得分、總得分的敘述統計")%>%   
  kable_styling(c("striped", "bordered"))%>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "生是非得分" = 2, "總得分" = 2))%>%
  column_spec(1, bold = T)

plot(Cdat1_yn$生是非得分, Cdat1_yn$技是非得分, pch=19)
plot(Cdat2_yn$生是非得分, Cdat2_yn$技是非得分, pch=19)
plot(Cdat1_yn.ju$生是非得分, Cdat1_yn.ju$技是非得分, pch=19,col=2)
plot(Cdat2_yn.ju$生是非得分, Cdat2_yn.ju$技是非得分, pch=19,col=2)
plot(Cdat1_yn.se$生是非得分, Cdat1_yn.se$技是非得分, pch=19,col=3)
plot(Cdat2_yn.se$生是非得分, Cdat2_yn.se$技是非得分, pch=19,col=3)

out<-data.frame(matrix(NA, 6, 4))
out[,1]<-rep(c("全部人","國中生","高中生"),each=2)
out[,2]<-rep(c("前測","後測"), 3)
kk<-c(paste("Cdat1_yn", c("",".ju",".se"),sep=""), paste("Cdat2_yn", c("",".ju",".se"),sep=""))
for(i in c(1,4,2,5,3,6)){
  k<-eval(parse(text=kk[i]))
  out[i,3]<-cor.test(k[["生是非得分"]], k[["技是非得分"]])[["estimate"]]%>%round(digits=4)
  out[i,4]<-ifelse(cor.test(k[["生是非得分"]], k[["技是非得分"]])[["p.value"]]<0.0001, "<0.0001",cor.test(k[["生是非得分"]], k[["技是非得分"]])[["p.value"]]%>%round(digits=4))
  
}



cor.test(Cdat1_yn$生是非得分, Cdat1_yn$技是非得分);cor.test(Cdat2_yn$生是非得分, Cdat2_yn$技是非得分)
cor.test(Cdat1_yn.ju$生是非得分, Cdat1_yn.ju$技是非得分);cor.test(Cdat2_yn.ju$生是非得分, Cdat2_yn.ju$技是非得分)
cor.test(Cdat1_yn.se$生是非得分, Cdat1_yn.se$技是非得分);cor.test(Cdat2_yn.se$生是非得分, Cdat2_yn.se$技是非得分)
```

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=8,warning=F}
Cdat_yn<-rbind(Cdat1_yn, Cdat2_yn)
Cdat_yn[["前/後測"]]<-rep(c("前測","後測"),each=dim(Cdat1_yn)[1])

Cdat_yn%>%
  dplyr::select(生是非得分,總得分,`前/後測`) %>%
  # gather 所有變數，除了 island 之外(要當成獨立一個欄位，做為群組)
  gather(key = 'variable', value = 'measurements', -`前/後測`)%>%
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = variable, y = measurements, col = `前/後測`)) +
	# 繪製盒鬚圖，使用 position_dodge 調整間距
    geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
    # 修改 x 軸標籤為 Soil properties
    labs(x = '項目',y="分數", title="前/後測生是非得分、總得分的盒形圖")+
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,100),breaks = seq(0,100,10))+
    theme(legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(face="bold",size=16),
          legend.title = element_text(size=14),
          legend.text = element_text(size=12),
          axis.title.x = element_text(face="bold",size=16),
          axis.title.y = element_text(face="bold",size=16),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size=12),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size=12))

```

###** 1-1-1 計算前後測總得分組距**
```{r}
cut(Cdat1_yn$總得分,seq(-1,101,10))%>%table()
cut(Cdat2_yn$總得分,seq(-1,101,10))%>%table()

# 進步幅度組距
cut(Cdat2_yn$總得分-Cdat1_yn$總得分, c(seq(-80,-1,10),-1,1,seq(9,80,10)))%>%table()
```

## **1-3 按後測總得分高低分組**
```{r}
type<-"後測總得分";num<-0.25

out<-matrix(NA,3,3)
rownames(out)<-c("高分組","平均組","低分組")
colnames(out)<-c("分組依據",type,"組內人數")

```

### **1-3-1 分組敘述統計（按後測總得分分組）**
```{r}
out[1,1]<-paste(type,"的前",num*100,"%",sep="")
out[2,1]<-paste(type,"的平均上下",(1-2*num)*100,"%",sep="")
out[3,1]<-paste(type,"的後",num*100,"%",sep="")
out[1,2]<-paste(quantile(Cdat2_yn$總得分,1-num),"分(含)以上",sep="")
out[2,2]<-paste(quantile(Cdat2_yn$總得分,num)+2.5,"~",quantile(Cdat2_yn$總得分,1-num)-2.5,"分",sep="")
out[3,2]<-paste(quantile(Cdat2_yn$總得分,num),"分(含)以下",sep="")
gpost.high<-Cdat2_yn$總得分>=quantile(Cdat2_yn$總得分,1-num)
gpost.low<-Cdat2_yn$總得分<=quantile(Cdat2_yn$總得分,num)

out[1,3]<-length(which(gpost.high));out[3,3]<-length(which(gpost.low));out[2,3]<-dim(Cdat2_yn)[1]-length(which(gpost.high))-length(which(gpost.low))

out%>%kable("html",escape = F,booktabs = TRUE, caption = "1-3-1 分組敘述統計（按後測總得分分組）")%>%   
  kable_styling(c("striped", "bordered"))%>%
  column_spec(1, bold = T)
```



### **1-3-2 是非題答對率之前後測結果比較（後測低分組vs.後測高分組）**
```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=10,warning=F}
kk<-yn.prepost.lowhigh.table(Cdat1_yn[which(gpost.low),],Cdat2_yn[which(gpost.low),],Cdat1_yn[which(gpost.high),],Cdat2_yn[which(gpost.high),])

colnames(kk)<-c("\u200B","\u200B","平均答對率","標準差","平均答對率","標準差","t統計量","p-value","檢定結果","前測","後測","後測")

kk[,8]<-str_c(kk[,8]%>%round(digits=3),cut(kk[,8], breaks=c(0,0.001,0.01,0.05,1),labels=c("***","**","*","")))

kk%>%kable("html",escape = F,booktabs = TRUE, digits=c(0,0,3,2,3,2,3,3,3,3,3,3),caption="1-3-2 是非題答對率之前後測結果比較（後測低分組n=45 vs.後測高分組n=39）")%>%   
  kable_styling(c("striped", "bordered"))%>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 2, "前測" = 2, "後測" = 2,"前後測成對t檢定" = 3,"鑑別度" = 2, "難度" = 1))%>%
  column_spec(1, bold = T)%>%
  collapse_rows(columns=c(1,10:12))%>%
  group_rows("生是非", 1, 60)%>%
  group_rows("技是非", 61, 80)

res_low<-yn.prepost.table(Cdat1_yn[which(gpost.low),], Cdat2_yn[which(gpost.low),])
res_high<-yn.prepost.table(Cdat1_yn[which(gpost.high),], Cdat2_yn[which(gpost.high),])
res<-rbind(res_low, res_high)

yn.prepost.plot.lowhigh(res, "是非題答對率之前後測結果比較（後測低分組vs.後測高分組）")
```


### **1-3-6 知識性質生是非前後測答對率（後測低分組n=45 vs.後測高分組n=39）**
```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=10,warning=F}
kk<-yn_life.prepost.compare.table(Cdat1_yn%>%filter(gpost.low),
                                  Cdat2_yn%>%filter(gpost.low),
                                  Cdat1_yn%>%filter(gpost.high),
                                  Cdat2_yn%>%filter(gpost.high),7)%>%
  arrange(知識性質)%>%dplyr::select(!c("知識性質","生活主題","覺察"))

colnames(kk)<-c("","","平均答對率","標準差","平均答對率","標準差","t統計量","p-value","檢定結果")

kk[,7]<-kk[,7]%>%as.numeric%>%round(digits=3)

kk[,8]<-str_c(kk[,8]%>%as.numeric%>%round(digits=3),cut(kk[,8]%>%as.numeric, breaks=c(0,0.001,0.01,0.05,1),labels=c("***","**","*","")))

kk%>%kable("html",escape = F,booktabs = TRUE, digits=c(0,0,3,2,3,2,3,3,3), caption="1-3-6 知識性質生是非前後測答對率（後測低分組n=45 vs.後測高分組n=39）")%>%   
  kable_styling(c("striped", "bordered"))%>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 2, "前測" = 2, "後測" = 2,"前後測成對t檢定" = 3))%>%
  column_spec(1, bold = T)%>%
  collapse_rows(columns = 1)%>%
  group_rows("知識", 1, 20)%>%
  group_rows("推論", 21, 50)%>%
  group_rows("計算", 51, 60)

res_postlow<-yn_life.prepost.table(Cdat1_yn%>%filter(gpost.low),
                               Cdat2_yn%>%filter(gpost.low))
res_nopostlow<-yn_life.prepost.table(Cdat1_yn%>%filter(gpost.high),
                                 Cdat2_yn%>%filter(gpost.high))
res<-rbind(res_postlow, res_nopostlow)

yn.prepost.compare.plot(res, "知識性質生是非答對率之前後測結果比較（後測低分組n=45 vs.後測高分組n=39）", state=7)+
  facet_grid(cols=vars(知識性質), scales = "free", space = "free")
```

## **1-4 按前測總得分高低分組**
```{r}
type<-"前測總得分";num<-0.25

out<-matrix(NA,3,3)
rownames(out)<-c("高分組","平均組","低分組")
colnames(out)<-c("分組依據",type,"組內人數")

```

### **1-4-1 分組敘述統計（按前測總得分分組）**
```{r}
out[1,1]<-paste(type,"的前",num*100,"%",sep="")
out[2,1]<-paste(type,"的平均上下",(1-2*num)*100,"%",sep="")
out[3,1]<-paste(type,"的後",num*100,"%",sep="")
out[1,2]<-paste(quantile(Cdat1_yn$總得分,1-num),"分(含)以上",sep="")
out[2,2]<-paste(quantile(Cdat1_yn$總得分,num)+2.5,"~",quantile(Cdat1_yn$總得分,1-num)-2.5,"分",sep="")
out[3,2]<-paste(quantile(Cdat1_yn$總得分,num),"分(含)以下",sep="")
```

## **2-2 計算全部人/國中生/高中生的分數彙整表格（分成全部是非題、僅覺察類兩種情形）**
```{r}
# 針對不同人分數的檢定（自由度來自人數）
mean_table.allsense<-function(data1,data2){
  
  all.pre<-data1$總得分
  all.post<-data2$總得分
  t_all<-t.test(all.post,all.pre,paired=T)
  t.all<-t_all$statistic[[1]]%>%round(digits=3)
  p.all<-t_all$p.value
  
  sense.pre<-rowSums(sapply(colnames(ans)[which(typee$sense==1)],function(i) (data1[[i]]==ans[[i]])))*2.5*length(ans)/sum(typee$sense==1)
  sense.post<-rowSums(sapply(colnames(ans)[which(typee$sense==1)],function(i) (data2[[i]]==ans[[i]])))*2.5*length(ans)/sum(typee$sense==1)
  t_sense<-t.test(sense.post,sense.pre,paired=T)
  t.sense<-t_sense$statistic[[1]]%>%round(digits=3)
  p.sense<-t_sense$p.value
  
  return(c(mean(all.pre)%>%round(digits=2),sd(all.pre)%>%round(digits=1),
           mean(all.post)%>%round(digits=2),sd(all.post)%>%round(digits=1),t.all,p.all,
           mean(sense.pre)%>%round(digits=2),sd(sense.pre)%>%round(digits=1),
           mean(sense.post)%>%round(digits=2),sd(sense.post)%>%round(digits=1),t.sense,p.sense))
}
```

```{r}
mean_table.lifes<-function(data1,data2,topic){
  if(topic=="覺察"){
    dd<-yn_life.prepost.table(data1,data2)%>%filter(覺察==1)
    res<-matrix(NA, 1, 6)
    mean.pre<-mean(dd$`答對率（前測）`);mean.post<-mean(dd$`答對率（後測）`)
    sd.pre<-sd(dd$`答對率（前測）`);sd.post<-sd(dd$`答對率（後測）`)
    ttest<-t.test(dd$`答對率（後測）`,dd$`答對率（前測）`,paired=T)
    t.test.t<-ttest$statistic[[1]]
    t.test.p<-ttest$p.value
  }else{
    dd<-yn_life.prepost.table(data1,data2)
    res<-matrix(NA, length(levels(dd[[topic]])), 6)
    mean.pre<-aggregate(dd$`答對率（前測）`,list(dd[[topic]]),"mean")$x
    mean.post<-aggregate(dd$`答對率（後測）`,list(dd[[topic]]),"mean")$x
    sd.pre<-aggregate(dd$`答對率（前測）`,list(dd[[topic]]),"sd")$x
    sd.post<-aggregate(dd$`答對率（後測）`,list(dd[[topic]]),"sd")$x
    t.test.t<-t.test.p<-c()
    for(i in levels(dd[[topic]])){
      if(sum(dd[[topic]]==i)<=2){
        t.test.t<-c(t.test.t,NA); t.test.p<-c(t.test.p,NA)
        next
      }
      group.pre<-dd[dd[[topic]]==i,]$`答對率（前測）`
      group.post<-dd[dd[[topic]]==i,]$`答對率（後測）`
      ttest<-t.test(group.post,group.pre,paired=T)
      t<-ttest$statistic[[1]]
      p<-ttest$p.value
      t.test.t<-c(t.test.t, t); t.test.p<-c(t.test.p, p)
      # s<-sapply(dd[dd[[topic]]==i,]%>%rownames(), function(i) data2[[i]]==ans[[i]])%>%as.vector()
      # s2<-sapply(dd[dd[[topic]]==i,]%>%rownames(), function(i) data1[[i]]==ans[[i]])%>%as.vector()
      # t.test(s, s2, pair=T)
    }
  }
  res[,1]<-mean.pre
  res[,2]<-mean.post
  res[,3]<-sd.pre
  res[,4]<-sd.post
  res[,5]<-t.test.t
  res[,6]<-t.test.p
  return(res)
}
```

```{r}
#Cfat<-eat[which(eat$`平均一餐熱量需求(kcal)`<700),]$流水號%in%Cdat1_yn$流水號

Cfat.bf<-Cdat1_yn$流水號%in%eat[which(eat$`早餐總熱量(kcal)`>=500),]$流水號
Cnofat.bf<-Cdat1_yn$流水號%in%eat[which(eat$`早餐總熱量(kcal)`<500),]$流水號

# dat1_yn.fat<-dat1_yn.1[which(dat1_yn.1$流水號%in%eat[which(eat$`平均一餐熱量需求(kcal)`>=700),]$流水號),]
```

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=10,warning=F}

                            Cdat2_yn%>%filter(Cfat&(Cfat.bf|Cnofat.bf)),
                            Cdat1_yn%>%filter(Cnofat&(Cfat.bf|Cnofat.bf)),
                            Cdat2_yn%>%filter(Cnofat&(Cfat.bf|Cnofat.bf)), 2)

#colnames(kk)<-c("","","平均答對率","標準差","平均答對率","標準差","t統計量","p-value","檢定結果")
```

```{r, warning=F}
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "三組早餐地點anova檢定(進步量)" = 2, "三組早餐地點Kruskal-Wallis檢定(進步量)" = 2, "事後檢定(進步量)" = 4))%>%
  column_spec(c(1,6), bold = T)%>%
  collapse_rows(columns = c(1,2,3,4,5))
```

### **10-5-3 全部生是非、知識性質及覺察類是非題盒形圖（超商n=75 vs. 早餐店n=17 vs. 家裡n=17）**

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=13,warning=F}
yn.prepost.compare.boxplot(Cdat1_yn%>%filter(C711&(Cfat.bf|Cnofat.bf)),
                           Cdat2_yn%>%filter(C711&(Cfat.bf|Cnofat.bf)),
                           Cdat1_yn%>%filter(Cbf&(Cfat.bf|Cnofat.bf)),
                           Cdat2_yn%>%filter(Cbf&(Cfat.bf|Cnofat.bf)), 
                           state=5,
                           data_c1 = Cdat1_yn%>%filter(Chome&(Cfat.bf|Cnofat.bf)), 
                           data_c2  = Cdat2_yn%>%filter(Chome&(Cfat.bf|Cnofat.bf)), title="全部生是非、知識性質及覺察類是非題盒形圖（早餐店n=17 vs. 超商n=75 vs. 家裡n=17）")
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5.5}
data_a1=Cdat1_yn%>%filter(C711&(Cfat.bf|Cnofat.bf))
data_a2=Cdat2_yn%>%filter(C711&(Cfat.bf|Cnofat.bf))
data_b1=Cdat1_yn%>%filter(Cbf&(Cfat.bf|Cnofat.bf))
data_b2=Cdat2_yn%>%filter(Cbf&(Cfat.bf|Cnofat.bf))
state=5
data_c1=Cdat1_yn%>%filter(Chome&(Cfat.bf|Cnofat.bf))
data_c2=Cdat2_yn%>%filter(Chome&(Cfat.bf|Cnofat.bf))
res<-list()
res[[1]]<-list(data_a1, data_a2)
res[[2]]<-list(data_b1, data_b2)
res[[3]]<-list(data_c1, data_c2)
kk2<-c("超商","傳統早餐店","家裡")

ansrate<-function(ques){

    ansrate<-list()
    for(i in 1:2){
      ansrate[[i]]<-list()
      for(j in 1:length(kk2)){
        ansrate[[i]][[j]]<-rowMeans(sapply(ques,function(ii) (res[[j]][[i]][[ii]]%>%as.numeric()==ans[[ii]]%>%as.numeric())))
      }
    }
    
    ansrate0<-data.frame(pre=ansrate[[1]]%>%unlist(),post=ansrate[[2]]%>%unlist(),
               type=sapply(1:length(kk2), function(i) rep(kk2[i],dim(res[[i]][[1]])[1]))%>%unlist())
    
    return(ansrate0)
}

dat<-list()
dat[[1]]<-ansrate(names(ans1))
dat[[2]]<-ansrate(names(ans1)[typee$know==levels(typee$know)[1]])
dat[[3]]<-ansrate(names(ans1)[typee$know==levels(typee$know)[2]])
dat[[4]]<-ansrate(names(ans1)[typee$know==levels(typee$know)[3]])
dat[[5]]<-ansrate(names(ans1)[typee$sense==1])
  
datt<-rbind(dat[[1]], dat[[2]], dat[[3]], dat[[4]], dat[[5]])
datt$group<-rep(c("全部生是非","知識","推論","計算","覺察"), each=109)

ggplot(datt, aes(x=pre))+
  geom_histogram()+
  facet_grid(group~type)

ggplot(datt, aes(x=post))+
  geom_histogram()+
  facet_grid(group~type)


```

# **11. 迴歸分析**
```{r}
school<-factor(Cdat1_yn$班級)
levels(school)<-c(rep("和平",6), rep("桃農",2),rep("錦和",2))

reg_data<-data.frame(ID=Cdat1_yn$ID,流水號=Cdat1_yn$流水號,
                     前測生是非得分=Cdat1_yn$生是非得分, 前測技是非得分=Cdat1_yn$技是非得分,
                     前測總得分=Cdat1_yn$總得分,
                     後測生是非得分=Cdat2_yn$生是非得分, 後測技是非得分=Cdat2_yn$技是非得分,
                     後測總得分=Cdat2_yn$總得分,
                     Cdat1_yn.st[,7:36], Cdat2_yn.st[,7:36],
                     性別=ifelse(Cboy,"男","女")%>%as.factor(),
                     教育程度=ifelse(Cdat1_yn$班級%in%c("901.0","902.0","903.0","904.0","905.0","906.0","國中"),"國中","高中")%>%as.factor(),
                     有無肥胖=ifelse(Cfat, "有", ifelse(Cnofat,"無",NA)),
                     有無早餐肥胖=ifelse(Cfat.bf, "有", ifelse(Cnofat.bf,"無",NA)),
                     早餐地點=ifelse(C711,"超商",ifelse(Cbf,"早餐店", ifelse(Chome,"家裡",NA))),
                     學校=school)

# reg_data%>%filter(學校=="桃農")%>%summarise(mean(後測生是非得分))

# reg_data%>%filter(教育程度=="高中")%>%summarise(mean(後測生是非得分))
```

## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{python}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
